what_it_is.prose: Ceinsys Tech Limited is a Nagpur-headquartered, BSE- and NSE-listed company operating in geospatial services and engineering/technology solutions. It reported a strong FY26: total revenue of about ₹660.7 crore (up 58% year-on-year), Profit After Tax of about ₹133.4 crore (up 111.1%), EBITDA of ₹144.9 crore at a 21.9% margin, and an order book of roughly ₹876 crore, with a net cash balance near ₹248 crore. Its business splits into a Geospatial & Engineering Services segment (₹358.8 crore in FY26, up 76%) and a Technology Solutions segment (₹300.9 crore, up 41%). Ceinsys's relevance to military aerospace is indirect and services-based rather than platform manufacture: in 2021 it acquired 100% of AllyGrow Technologies Private Limited (for up to ~₹68.07 crore), an engineering-design services company, extending Ceinsys into product and mechanical engineering design that serves aerospace and industrial OEMs; and its geospatial, mapping and engineering work has defence-adjacent applications (terrain intelligence, infrastructure and asset mapping). Direct, publicly retrievable primary evidence of Ceinsys holding named Indian military-aircraft or defence-platform contracts is limited, so this entry is tiered B and framed honestly around its listed financials, its AllyGrow engineering-design capability, and its defence-adjacent geospatial services rather than any claim of aerospace platform production.

faq.question: What is Ceinsys Tech and how is it relevant to military aerospace?
faq.answer: Ceinsys Tech is a Nagpur-based, BSE/NSE-listed company in geospatial services and engineering/technology solutions. Its military-aerospace relevance is indirect: through its 2021 acquisition of engineering-design firm AllyGrow Technologies it provides mechanical/product engineering-design services that serve aerospace and industrial OEMs, and its geospatial and mapping work has defence-adjacent applications. It is a services provider, not an aircraft or systems manufacturer.

faq.question: How did Ceinsys perform financially in FY26?
faq.answer: For FY26 Ceinsys reported total revenue of about ₹660.7 crore, up 58% year-on-year, and Profit After Tax of about ₹133.4 crore, up 111.1%, with EBITDA of ₹144.9 crore at a 21.9% margin and an order book of roughly ₹876 crore. Its Geospatial & Engineering Services segment contributed ₹358.8 crore (up 76%) and Technology Solutions ₹300.9 crore (up 41%).
